blurb: Trips aboard the New Captain Pete include an experienced and courteous deckhand to assist with tackle, provide fishing tips, and clean your fish. The boat is 53 feet long, cruises at 15 knots, and can carry up to 38 anglers. Amenities include a heated cabin and separate heads for men and women.
